title: Zig-Zags at the Zoo
content: Zig Zags at the Zoo was a lighthearted illustrated feature that appeared in London'sStrand Magazinein the 1890s.The articles were written by Arthur Morrison and illustrated byJames Affleck Shepherd. Each article featured a different animal, such as a bear (above), lion, camel, simian, and fish.Like the work ofT. S. SullivantandHeinrich Kley, Shepherd's drawings show the animals in different anthropomorphic guises, clearly based on observation.-----Find Out MoreZig Zags at the ZooStrand Magazine(free download at Archive.org)All the articles collected on Project GutenbergJ.A.
